treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Estonia and the Government of the Republic of Singapore for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2006, as amended by Protocol 2011)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 52. | Singapore | 02.10.1998 | 18.09.2006 | 17.10.2007 ( est/eng ) | 27.12.2007 | 01.01.2008 |  || Protocol |  || 26.07.2010 | 03.02.2011 | 23.11.2011 ( est/eng ) | 30.03.2012 | 30.03.2012 |
source_title: EE-SG Agreement 2006 with Protocol (Riigi Teataja akt 12877150, est/eng) + Amending Protocol 2011 (akt 216122011004)

rates.quote: (a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
(b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 7.5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Estonia reserved MLI Art. 35(7)(a); its Art. 35(7)(b) notifications (25.11.2021, 01.06.2022) do not include this treaty, so the MLI (incl. PPT) has not yet effect.

notes: Dividends and interest exempt at source when beneficially owned by the other State's Government (incl. Bank of Estonia; MAS, GIC, statutory bodies) - Arts 10(3)-(4), 11(3)-(4). Protocol para 2: Singapore currently levies no tax on dividends beyond the corporate tax; Art. 10(2)-(3) apply to Singapore-source dividends only if Singapore introduces such a tax. Effective: Estonia WHT on income derived from 2008-01-01 (Art. 28(2)(a)); Singapore from year of assessment beginning 1 January 2009. Protocol 2011 (in force 30.03.2012) only replaces Art. 26 (exchange of information). Both States list the treaty under the MLI but Estonia has not notified Art. 35(7)(b) for Singapore.
